note: First verdict 2026-10-21 (round 4 judge). Row is a verbatim span of RFC 5250 Section 5 (2). Positive: a Type-11 LSA whose originator has no ASBR entry (SPF pending, reached without E-bit, unknown originator) is delivered not usable; negative: an originator with an ASBR entry is delivered usable, so the do-nothing rule is bound to the missing entry. Consumers honouring the not-usable flag (TED) are proven by the RFC5250-5-2 tests. Records on ASBRReachable.
